title: SearchRequest
description: A scoped search over the application's authorised sources (master plan 14.2, 12.4). The body can only NARROW a search: the application, tenant, workspace and principal come from the verified request context and are never read from here, so there is no member for any of them and, the object being closed, a body that tries to supply one is rejected. Every member is supplied by the caller (a client, the host application, or a model-proposed call) and is untrusted until validated, so every member is 'model'. source_ids is intersected with the sources the principal is authorised for; an ID outside that set is dropped without saying whether it exists. Results never contain anything outside the verified scope, whatever this body asks.

query.description: The question or search text, at most 2000 characters and at least one non-space character. Treated as data: it is matched against the index, never executed or interpreted as an instruction to the core.

source_ids.description: Optional. Search only these sources (at most 32). Absent means every source the principal is authorised for.

limit.description: Optional. The most results to return, 1 to 50. Absent means the deployment default. The core may return fewer: the evidence budget caps the result whatever is asked.
